comment: Marine forecast zone coverage per route. FR zones: Météo-France côte/large (BMS via data.gouv mirror). UK zones: Met Office shipping forecast areas (gale warnings from the print page). US zones: NWS coastal marine zones (active alerts via api.weather.gov, keyed by nws_zone UGC code). Meteoalarm zones: national CAP warnings aggregated by meteoalarm.org, keyed by EMMA_ID geocode + feed country — coastal zones only, high-seas bulletins are not distributed via Meteoalarm. AU zones: BOM marine wind warning summaries via anonymous FTP XML, keyed by AAC area code + state product id (e.g. IDQ20085 Queensland) — coastal waters zones only, BOM high-seas products not fetched.
